oracle_scope_limitation: Qualification establishes only canonical ground-truth satisfaction of pinned AgentDojo predicates. In particular, InjectionTask3.security requires exactly one matching email and an exact recipient list, so duplicate or extra-recipient exfiltration can be under-detected. Any future efficacy paper needs an independent monotone post-effect/canary oracle or must limit claims to the upstream AgentDojo predicate.
non_claims: This artifact contains zero LLM, guard, endpoint, provider, network, remote-job, utility, latency, or cost observations.
The three selected cases are a source-qualified feasibility subset, not a benchmark result, population estimate, ASR/AFER estimate, causal comparison, or Q2-readiness result.
The v2 selection does not unblock the historical v1 execution plan, create a benign twin, or authorize a billable run.
